title: GenreProfile
description: Genre module interface. Defines the vocabulary of scene functions, ontology extensions, quality gates, and reader contract specific to one genre. All genre-specific parameters are data here; code is the universal engine. See IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md Phase 4 T4.2.

schema_version.description: Schema version this profile was authored against.

parent_genre.description: If this is a subtype module (e.g. erotica extends romance), the parent genre_id. Null for top-level genres.

scene_function_vocabulary.description: Valid scene_function values for this genre. Extends the universal scene_function enum in scene.schema.json.

required.description: If true, at least one scene with this function is required for a valid book.

ontology_extensions.description: Genre-specific fields that extend the Universal Core ontology (e.g. romance adds heat_level, consent_arc; thriller adds knowledge_state, evidence_objects). Stub — enumerate per genre during Phase 5 implementation.

structural_conventions.description: Structural constraints for books in this genre. Stub — expand during Phase 5.

quality_gates.description: Genre-specific quality criteria applied by QualityAgent. Each gate is a named check with a threshold.

threshold_type.description: Whether the metric must be ≥, ≤, or near the threshold.

sacred.description: If true, cannot be relaxed on FORCE-RESOLVE.

self_audit_rubric.description: LLM-evaluated rubric items for genre-specific craft (e.g. 'HEA/HFN emotionally earned', 'Tension arc maintained'). Stub — enumerate per genre during Phase 5 implementation.

question.description: Yes/no or scored question for the self-audit LLM.

reader_contract.description: What readers of this genre implicitly expect. Used by Reader agent for satisfaction evaluation.

required_satisfactions.description: Things that must happen for reader satisfaction (e.g. 'HEA or HFN for romance').

forbidden_disappointments.description: Things that guarantee DNF or negative reviews.
